download.title: Litma for your computer
download.body: The same Litma, as an app for Mac and Windows. Your work syncs with the web.
download.soon: The first release is on its way
download.navTitle: Download Litma for Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android
download.heroLink: Get the app for Mac and Windows
download.heroBody: The same Malayalam writing desk as on the web, in its own window. Your works sync with your account everywhere.
download.inApp: You're already using the Litma app.
download.allBody: Pick another device or get Litma for someone else.
download.macReq: macOS 11 Big Sur or later. One app for Apple silicon and Intel.
download.iosReq: For iPhone and iPad. On its way to the App Store.
download.androidReq: For Android phones and tablets. On its way to Google Play.
download.mobileSoon: The mobile app is on its way. Until then, Litma works in your phone's browser.
download.linuxSoon: There's no Linux app yet, but Litma works fully in your browser.
download.webBody: Litma runs in any modern browser, on any computer or phone.

steps.mac1: Open Litma.dmg from your Downloads folder.
steps.mac2: Drag Litma into the Applications folder.
steps.mac3: The first time, right-click Litma in Applications and choose Open, then Open again.
steps.win1: Open Litma-win.exe from your Downloads folder.
steps.win2: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway.
steps.win3: Follow the installer. Litma opens when it's done and adds a desktop shortcut.

download.unsignedNote: Litma isn't signed with an Apple or Microsoft certificate yet, so your computer asks once before opening it. The app is the same as this website.
download.autoUpdate: Litma updates itself: when a new version is out, the app offers to install it.
download.deskBody: Faster to open, its own window, and it keeps working when the connection drops.

novel.blurb: Chapters (numbered if you like), scene breaks and indented paragraphs, set like a printed book.

story.blurb: A single sitting: title, byline and clean prose with section breaks.

poem.blurb: Verse line by line, in stanzas, with an akshara counter and laghu–guru marks for വൃത്തം.

screenplay.blurb: Malayalam film format: numbered scenes, Int./Ext. and time, cast list, action on the left, dialogue in two columns.

feature.blurb: Magazine layout: kicker, headline, standfirst, byline, subheads, pull quotes, info boxes and footnotes.

essay.blurb: Argument-first prose with headings, quotations, footnotes and references.

drama.blurb: Stage play: cast list, numbered acts and scenes (അങ്കം, രംഗം), stage directions and speaker lines.

lyrics.blurb: പല്ലവി, അനുപല്ലവി, ചരണം: labelled parts, repeat lines, song details and metre counts.

diary.blurb: Dated entries for journals, travelogues and memoir drafts. New entry adds today's date.

blank.blurb: An empty A4 page. Use any heading or block from the toolbar.
